changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='CIX_GraphAssetNode_AssetId' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('[graph].[AssetNode]')) begin CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_GraphAssetNode_AssetId] ON [graph].[AssetNode] (ID) end
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='CIX_GraphAssetNode_AssetId' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID('[graph].[AssetNode]')) begin DROP INDEX [CIX_GraphAssetNode_AssetId] ON [graph].[AssetNode] end
